cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the wedding meal. You may introduce its creator before dessert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just say a big thank-you to the buffet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may thank me by name. The buffet has trained for twenty years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. How do I pronounce your surname?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're authorized to practise it with me. We'll hold dessert until you're ready to give the buffet its full credit.

heightening.evidence: B4 solution becomes A5 approved practice, extending the recognition demand into control over meal service.
